text: Had a great time at Logan's the food is great and the best part are the Waitress Tatiana and Tammy (the new waitresses ) who gave us a great experience with their hospitality skills . Will be back on our trip back to New York . To enjoy the delicious food and service

Best pizza in the area, hands down! It's dangerous that Grimaldi's is so accessible to us, because I *try* not to eat pizza too often, but this pizza is hard to resist! What sets it apart is the cheese. It's not your normal shredded mozzarella, it's the real deal, fresh mozzarella. Smaller pepperoni, that gets crispy along the edges. You know what I'm talking about, the best kind of pepperoni! No need to look further, you've found the best pizza in Boise!

So out of all the hype between Pat's and Geno's. I choose Jim's as one of the best steak sandwich's I ever had. But they don't have fries and they don't have the whole sweet and hot peppers as Pat's and Geno's does. But other than that Jim's is #1!

We were the last customers let in, as they had run out of most items.  Although the menu was limited, we greatly enjoyed the crab cakes and snapper, with fresh sides.  Recommend you try to get there early!

We made a reservation here but arrived to find staff not uniformly wearing masks and so we told them we weren't going to stay. One of the staff then began shouting obscenities at my wife.  Never have we experienced anything like it. We were in the parking lot with our daughter and son in law figuring out alternate plans and the same person came out screaming and threatening again telling us to get off his property to the point that I called 911.   This restaurant is in a strip mall and we weren't even in front of the place.  Another staff person came out and tried to calm this person down and then they wanted us to come in which we weren't comfortable doing and then the other guy came back shouting nor expletives. They accused us of racism which is absolutely not the issue. It's Covid and our expectation is to dine out the law and basic common sense should be followed. Needless to say we will not be returning and I couldn't recommend a place less.

Decided to stop at the Dunkin on Grant and Swan on a Saturday morning about 9am as we were getting ready to head back up the mountain to go home.  There was only two people in front of me inside.  One was ordering a lot of donuts and that was understandable.  The person immediately in front of me ordered four coffee type beverages.  It took well over twenty minutes.   I ended up receiving my full order before hers was done.  

All I ordered was:

1 Southwest Veggie Flatbread Sandwich
1 Large Hot Coffee with oat milk.

The sandwich was absolutely disgusting.  The oat milk was a waste of $1 and it made the coffee not drinkable.  That is not necessarily the fault of Dunkin, but after 20 minutes, I was not a happy camper.  

We have a saying on the Mountain that people are on Mountain Time, meaning that people are quite slow, etc.  However, the employees at this dunkin have a lot of work before they are only at Mountain Time.  

If I could give negative stars, I would. All in all it was an absolutely horrible experience and they are definitely deserving of a one star review.

Stopped in yesterday with my boyfriend the girl upfront was so helpful and sweet we got a couple Togo sandwiches they were both amazing! We didn't get any beer this time around but they have a great mix and match selection that I will definitely be coming back for. Definitely recommend this place.
Awesome  pie great flavors  clean  and staff is friendly chicken  fingers look  good Pepsi  products  and beer  and stuff

I'm pretty surprised to see some negative reviews on this place. I tried it for the first time today after hearing great things, and the pizza did not disappoint. It's definitely not your "traditional" pizza if you're looking for that, but it's great in its own way. The pizza was soft yet crunchy, the sauce was nice and kinda sweet, and it wasn't too cheesy which I liked. I ordered pepperoni and wished they put more on it though...especially since they charge per topping.
Ordered breakfast sandwiches from here and they were so good! I got a pork roll egg and cheese. It was a little greasy but delicious!

Have been in to restaurant pre-pandemic, have now ordered a ton since quarantine. I've picked up and had postmates drop it at the door. Quality is consistent every time. I suggest the chili noodz if they're available. All the fried rice variations are incredible. It's a way to get takeout Chinese and feel a little less guilty due to fresh ingredients and care taken in preparation.

New Asian place that pleased our pallet. The two of us were hungry but not famished. We split a huge steaming bowl of pork Ramen and had a couple of sushi rolls. The ramen was very savory with generous slices of pork tenderloin. The noodles were cooked perfectly with a bit of bite and definitely not mushy. The sushi rolls were well balanced with less rice and more meat than many other restaurants. This night they had Saki bombs at 4 for $10. Even with that we left with a check for under $40!  Our server was excellent and attentive. We highly recommend this dining experience.

Made a reservation for 4 people, one guest was going to be arriving late and Restaurant wouldn't seat us, made us wait for the late guest. There WAS NO OTHER TABLES occupied in the entire outdoor area and we had to wait 25 mins.  Haven't been in a while and decided to try again and was still disappointed- none of our food looked or tasted fresh.  Lettuce was old and chicken tastes like frozen chicken strips from a chain restaurant. Got a lobster Cobb no lobster and was still charged full price.  It's a shame the food used to be so good!

Wonderful Caring People who know how to make people happy with their delicious food. Hands down the best place for take out during these pandemic times. His pizzas are awesome. Always consider them for your personal and corporate events for catering.

I was a fan of their's on the Southside and ha e willingly made the trek north. The Burmese items on this menu are readily available on the Southside of Indy (do yourself a favor and try out some of those restaurants too), but the lemongrass chicken and Burmese style soup are a go to here. The owners will meetbyiur needs if there are vegetarians or vegans in your group. Get in to try authentic and delicious Burmese food.

Came here for the first time today and was so impressed! I've been almost everywhere for brunch in Tampa and this food was definitely the best! The service was exceptional as well! I believe our server was Justin and he was on top of everything! Will definitely be coming back soon to try dinner!

Great French inspired food. The menu online is slightly different from what is currently available (cocktails and meal components), so an update is needed. We opted for outdoor dining, and it was positioned in a way where there is no foot traffic which is great. This is a fairly new restaurant, with beautiful plating serving some french classics with a twist. On to the food.

Drinks: Presently Waiting and Sunday Driver. Both were delicious, but the presently waiting was one of the best drinks that I've ever had. 

Appetizers- Herb Ricotta Gnudi and Tomato Tartine. The gnudi was textbook, with a delicious Cacio e Pepe sauce. They offer complimentary bread with some amazing lime honey butter, and thankfully I saved a few pieces to sop up the leftover sauce. The Tomato Tartine was also excellent. The tomato jam, bright multi colored tomatoes and avocado cream went well together.

Entrees- Rohan Duck and Pocono Trout. The duck was cooked perfectly with a great crust, served with green lentils and blueberries. The trout was pretty good, it was really light, fish was flakey and the almond butter foam was great. The wax beans and micro greens fell flat though. The exterior of the bean was tough, and the micro greens didn't do much for the dish. 

Dessert- Chocolate Torte and Angel Cake. The torte was stellar! It had a nice fudgy consistency, like a molten chocolate cake cooked a bit too long (not in a bad way). The passion fruit curd helped cut the richness. The Angel Cake dessert w

Wegmans is the best!! I was so glad when they opened up 6 years ago! I live about 25 minutes away but It is definitely worth the trip. What's not to love? Its next to 309 and a mall, plenty of parking, they sell beer, wine and liquor, the cafes are great with no shortage of places to eat (indoor and outdoor), and the food is fantastic too! My personal highlights is the Intense Chocolate Milk (which I can't find anywhere else), the pizza station, the bakery (the cupcakes and cookies alone are worth the trip), and the candy aisle (all so healthy, I know). There is plenty of registers to go to and all the employees are friendly and very helpful. I wish I lived a little closer otherwise I'd be shopping here weekly, but when I can make the trip it is very worth it. If you are in the area stop in, you won't be disappointed.

New place that has opened near city hall to cater for center city business district. I had a lot of expectations given it's global presence. Ordered lunch here through Grubhub for pickup. Food was ready by the time I reached. I ordered a falafel bowl with hummus and vegetables. It was good but nothing to write home about. There are plenty of middle eastern quick bite places in center city now so this place has a lot of competition and doesn't stand up to it. I would rate Naf Naf Grill better than Naya. 

Try it if you're in the neighborhood and want a quick bite. Not work it to travel to specially come here for food.

Decided to finally give this place a try. I love my Mexican food and spice. I ended up trying their carne asada burrito and it was great. All meat with a little bit of Pico de gallo and guacamole, no rice or beans just MEAT. The second best part is they lived up to their name. Their habanero salsa was on point. I will definitely be back to this place and soon.

Terrible management. Normal working day with hours showing open and online ordering open. When we reached the restaurant, they had hand written note saying closed today. Would advise everyone to not use there online ordering services.

I kept seeing people raving about this Thai restaurant so I decided to give it a try. We got spring rolls, beef drunken noodles, and chicken pad Thai. Everything was great but I highly recommend the drunken noodles! Also, the portions are large so you definitely get your money's worth. Good spot if you're looking for Thai food or something different to try!

Ordered a carry-out for a party of 12 and was very disappointed when I arrived and my order was not done. I had to wait as they didn't have the cornbread and had to cook another batch. Just frustrated a little cause my guests show up and I won't be there to greet them. I might think twice next time and may use a more reliable restaurant.

Quiet, quaint little place. Loved it! Had the elk chops and polenta and my girlfriend had table side filet. Enjoyed a great bottle of wine and shared  some after dinner limoncellos with the owner ON THE HOUSE! Will definitely be back
Soooo it's just reheated frozen food? The calamari was super fishy and the burger not fresh. Just felt like microwaved frozen meals at a high price.

Sarah, Matt, Kyle, and Mike are the best bartenders I have ever encountered. I would die for the saloon. I would cross any river and any mountain to be here. They make the BEST FRENCH 75's and COSMOS. Love the pulled pork nachos!! The owner is great! Got to be here. Xoxo Mel and Cass.
The food tasted pretty good. However they took forever preparing it. And they were tiny portions
SouthHouse is great. The food is fresh. The service is amazing. The beer selection is fire. If you're in the area, go, you won't regret it.
Open for dine in. Amazing food. This was my first experience with Indian and I am very pleased. Chicken tiki masala was excellent. I love the Lental wafer served with the dips.

The absolute best part of the pizza is the crust.  Pizza is very well made, and the ingredients are fresh.  Definitely a spot to stop by.  Only downside is the price is a little high.  I would recommend to any pizza fan, who doesn't mind paying a bit.  Dipping the crust in honey is also amazing.
Sawyer mason, POPPIN SERVERRR so clutch 10/10 on god. Girlfriends easy on the eyes. Let's get it

Really liked this place.  Wife and I stopped by here for the first time and was greeted by smiling faces.  Had a Chicago dog and their homemade chips are really good.  Definitely will come back here.  Prices are good as well.

Great food and environment to eat right on the Basque Block. We came for dinner and are eager to return for brunch because we've heard great things. If you haven't been to Leku Ona for a while, it's definitely worth returning!

We got a few different dishes, and they were all quite bland and boring. This is quite the tourist trap and cater to the drunk and people who do not know crawfish if it swam up to them. Not recommended if you want a real taste of creol cuisine. Thumbs down and pass on this place.

It's been a while since I stopped by and had a bite and had heard someone talking about how they had remodeled a while back so I thought it was time to take a peak. The remodel turned out good! Basically the same layout and a different color scheme. Today we tried the street tacos and finger steaks. Both were good but a little lacking. The chicken was just diced chicken without a ton of flavor but it was tender. The rest of the taco was really good with some good spice and flavors. The corn tortillas were warmed up and crispy which was a nice touch. The finger steaks were super tender but a little on the batter was undercooked and on the soggy side. Service was amazing and friendly!

Blond bartender needs a lesson in hospitality and she needs to pull her hair back. I know for a fact that is a health code violation and shame on management for allowing that. Was way to long and in her face that there is no way there wasn't hair in people foods/drinks. I watched her interact with other guests and not once was there a welcome or smile.

I was really yearning for some Iranian food and randomly came across Caspian Grille. I am so happy I did.

A lot of people cook food but very few cook with a smile. As you can see in the picture I attached. The owner and quite frankly the star of the place is making some Persian rice. Everything here looks home made and fresh. If you ask for suggestions on what to order they are kind and will help you out.

I got the lamb gyro platter and I loved it. The meat was flavorful. I really judge a place by how good their rice is. Rice is a simple dish but hard to perfect  if you don't know what you are doing, their rice was amazing. I also really liked the yogurt that came with the platter. Highly recommend the cucumber salad. 

I enjoyed my meal and more importantly my conversation with the owner who takes pride in his food and his restaurant. This is a gem of a restaurant and embodies the charm that we have come to associate family owned restaurants with.

So I came to pick a order at this restaurant and food was not ready I set by the bar area and the bartender with long hair  told me to move and set somewhere else I thing he doesn't have the manners and right costumer service that are required for his position

Really good quality place to dine. I don't think there is anywhere in Bucks County that compares. I've been a customer at this location for over 30 + years from the Stone Manor Inn, the Yacht Club, the Wookie Hole, Buckingham Steak House & for the last 20 years, Baci. If your looking for a casual Pub type atmosphere visit the downstairs bar. Good Beer selection & excellent food. Looking for a dining experience, then it's upstairs where you'll be impressed with a creative menu of deliciously prepared food that will guarantee your return, never disappointing. Along with the decor, ambience  & service it truly is simply the best. If you've never been, your missing out, really ! 
Bob N Doylestown

As lebanese person, it is really refreshing to find a place in Philadelphia, away from home that serves authentic lebanese food. The hummus is soo creamy, the falafel so crunchy and flavorful, and the chicken tawook kabob is bursting with flavor. I have been returning to this reasturant soo often, it is hard to get tired lf this place, it just feels like a home away from home. Some of the staff here are also soo welcoming, and friendly. I already excited for my next trip to this place.
We go twice a year minimum.  Consistently good.  Never disappointed.  We have our favorites like the sea bass but  anytime we try one of their specials it is always good.

Hot chicken sandwich was amazing. Was a fun place with no band playing so you could eat and have a conversation. Friend had the Mac and cheese with hot chicken and he loved it. Definitely worth a visit.

The menu that is online is NOT correct.... Some things they don't have on menu and the prices are wrong.... Food is ok.... I know I won't be back... I suggest to update the web site.. He said, something to me which I couldn't understand was saying it to me in a mean voice and blow me off.
Absolutely awful! Went for Christmas and the worst meal possible. Don't try it. The service was also horrible and we got no refills on drinks and waited 30 minutes for our order to be taken.

Exceptional find! We happened upon this place and had a great evening.   The staff was attentive, comfortable atmosphere,  great music and there were so many wines to choose from. Looking forward to visiting again soon.
Love this place. Staff remembers you and makes you feel welcomed. Everything on the menu is good.

Still the best cheesesteaks in the Tampa Bay area, but I am reducing the rating as well as my number of visits each month because I am so sick and tired of the attitude of the women who work the counter. Seriously?! Is it that hard to be friendly? 

People frequently say that immigrants should assimilate into American culture. I agree wholeheartedly. I also think Northerners should assimilate into Southern culture. In other words, leave the Philly, Jersey and New York attitudes up north where they belong. Learn to be friendly. Say "Hello, how are you?" and freakin mean it. Most of all, quit acting like your customers are an annoyance that you have to tolerate.  

Also, why make customers stand in line twice? (Once to order, then another time to pay).  And sweep the floor. Damn. It looked like an cheesesteak bomb exploded. 

My mission is to find a comparable cheesesteak without the attitude....and when I do it's adios Delcos.

UPDATE 9/25/2019 

Today I went and there were nice, friendly people working there AND I only had to stand in line once. The cheesesteak was delicious. It's 5 stars again.
Love this place! The beans and the brisket there are delicious. Service is always pleasant and the price, considering it's BBQ, is decent.

Another amazing experience tonight at Taso Italiano. If you haven't been yet, you're missing something really special. The food, the atmosphere, Taso, Sabrina and Esterina are a combination that you won't find elsewhere. If you are looking for true, delicious Italian food, check them out, you'll be so glad you did!
So good! Definitely deserves the hype! Great prices, too! Would return, but probably order less food! My boyfriend and I couldn't finish what we ordered! The milkshake was super delicious and cheap!

I ordered delivery. Wontons were very thick and doughy. Not very good. Pork fried rice and vegetable lo mein were good but greasy. Food arrived promptly and was steaming hot which was great. 
I would order again but not won ton soup and probably avoid dumplings too based on reviews. I usually request very light oil with Chinese food but forgot to request this time.

Kevin Darrish is very unpleasant. He doesn't greet guests and seems to dislike his job. I bought a gift card with you all and he was very rude. He kept mumbling things under his breath as if he didn't want to assist me. I actually greeted him first. His reply was disingenuous. The employees looked so embarrassed. I won't come back. I actually regret my purchase and seeing his face at the start of my morning.

Lasagna should not taste like it came out of a barbeque. Worst vegetarian lasagna I ever tasted.  Fried Brussels sprouts good, but  the porridge hiding underneath had absolutely no flavor. What was it? Couldn't figure out why it wasceven there or what it was made of. Yuck. Blah. Will not return.

Absolutely delicious. Felt comfortable eating inside. Food hot, tasty, salty, crispy, exactly how it should be. Bold rock cider on draft was ice cold and sooo nice on a hot Friday afternoon. Lisa S. Is probably the most friendly person in Brentwood. You can't see her smile under the mask but you can sure hear it in her voice. Even in our quick interaction she left an impression. Thank you for that. Covid is tough but for a few seconds it didn't feel like a pandemic.

The food and drinks are as advertised; great quality ingredients prepared the English way. The menu is a mix of different foods from different regions of UK and would be a nice place to visit for those whom want to try cuisine. 
The drinks were well prepared and delicious and the staff was super friendly.

My burrito was amazing!!! I don't like places where i have to make decisions so the thing that i loved about this place is that even tho you can make ur own, the menu board has pre-selected combos like my citrus braised pork burrito!!!  I was asked if i wanted something, but i had no idea what he was talking about. They assumed that i had been there before. Would have loved to have tried more food and explore other options, but i felt a little rushed since They were closing soon.
 The price was right, the burrito was great! I would definitely go back

Went to Iron Hill in Maple Shade tonight.  We arrived early to avoid any crowds.  We sat ourselves in a booth as the girl at the reception booth instructed us.  At least five wait staff walked by us like we were invisible.  FINALLY a waitress came over.  First thing she did was ask how many in our party.  Which we thought was hysterical. My sister and I (thats two) were sitting there for at least ten minutes.  She got us menus and immediately asked if we were ready to order.  We had not even opened the menus.

Things settled in and LAURIE took our orders and left.  Drinks came promptly.  But our food was a no show.  The booth behind us had had their appetizer, their main meal and were working on dessert.  No food for us.  
Finally a good 30 minutes our burgers arrived.  LAURIE was waiting on the tater totes she said.  My sister's french fries were cold.  But both of us had delicious burgers.  Time to get our check.  But LAURIE is chatting with another couple.  Five, Ten minutes LAURIE is still chatting.  Fifteen, twenty minutes LAURIE is continuing her chat.  

Enough.  I went to get a manager.  STEPHANIE came to our table with our check.  Began to bus the table and went to box our food.  Meanwhile, LAURIE, was still chatting.  STEPHANIE came with our boxed food.  LAURIE - still chatting.  Stephanie did her job quickly and with poise.  Finally LAURIE came back to our table we were putting our coats on.  She asked if we were still okay and I let her have it LOUD and clear.

We tried the Chicken, Pork and a third unmemorable Tacos, the Pazole Verde soup was the best item. I thought the tacos were rather flavorless, dry and were missing some accoutrements that typically come with great  tacos. There is also a lack of good salsas.

In the times that we live in nowadays it is neither shocking how mistreated consumers are....... I understand there was a shutdown for covid-19 but you have been back online for a week now and I have still yet receive a refund for a trip cancellation in April because of covid lockdown in my home state...... it is amazing that companies want your monies for the services right away but as when it comes to returning said customers monies it take an act of god....... people be aware this is not how you should be treated.....and companies under strain these days may file chapter 11 bankruptcy and you will lose your money if you have not received a refund with no recourse....... I WANT MY MONEY BACK NOW!
Docs is the absolute best bbq in town! They do an awesome job on their burnt ends, if you order them in time!  They do sell out of things frequently bc they are just that awesome!
Had Postmates delivery for a $13.00 Souvlaki plate - 1 very small stick of beef and no tzatziki!!  Definitely not worth it.

Nice atmosphere for lunch, cute patio and a enjoyed the music. The side salad was nothing spectacular. It was pretty bland and really basic, just spring mix lettuce and a very light dressing. I'd suggest some other side. The brisket sandwich was ok. I would've appreciated if the bread was toasted more on the outside. The brisket itself was tinder but could be better seasoned. The sauce and cheese on it is good. If I come again I'd try something else.

Sushi was decent for Tucson, but the issue with this place is that their prices on their own online menu are different than the ones I was charged. $5 extra then what I was planning on paying. I talked to the manager and they wouldn't honor their own menu. I understand covid times but as a loyal customer I was blindsided tonight. Serviced was great but how can you not honor your own menu? CYA

This is my first time here, but I have been looking for a crumb type donut for over a year.  I decided this morning was the morning so I drove from Eagle to explore and I am so glad I did.  They had it!!  I only bought 4 donuts, but they were all delicious and the woman behind the counter was very nice.  Looks like I am driving from Eagle to Boise again in the near future!!!

This is a super tough review to write. The location is very convenient after an event at Amalie. Unfortunately that's where the pluses end. In fact under normal circumstances, this would be a 2 star experience by me at best.

Dined there on 4/12 after the hockey game. There was plenty of room outdoors yet it still took us over 10 minutes to be seen and seated. It took even longer than that for a server to come bye and begin the process of taking an order. At least our server had a great attitude and did her best to make up for the wait. 

The food itself was very mixed. The signature 1905 Salad was delicious. No question.

The main course, mahi-mahi was fair at best. It was one square piece of very dense near tasteless fish. Possibly frozen. It was dry without any Moho sauce as I asked for no raw onions. The yellow rice was sticky and bushy. There were 2 tiny plantains. probably the best thing going for it was it was not all that expensive.


Would I come back again, unlikely.
Great local restaurant with good food and a fun atmosphere. We like the warmth and friendliness of it and go all year round. Looking forward to the outside dining In summer

Work brings me to Indy a ton, so I love exploring new restaurants. The foodie in me loves a great experience with yummy food.

Sullivan's is a nicer steakhouse in the North part of Indy. Don't worry if you are a seafood lover like me, there are lots of option. I would start with making a reservation if possible. You can find them on OpenTable.

Sullivan's had no problem finding our reservation and seated up promptly. Our waiter was so passionate about his job, which elevated our experience. I hate to say that I had a glass of wine or true and I can't remember his name! Ah! 

We started off with brussel sprouts (hold the bacon) and some warm yummy bread. So hard to have self-control around carbs, especially hot yummy bread! 

I ordered the tuna steak seared rare. Double yum! My colleagues enjoyed the brick chicken and the salmon. No complaints. 

Did we have room for dessert?! We made room for dessert! This amazing dessert tray comes out to make you drool. I wanted everything! We decided to go with the bread pudding with vanilla ice cream. Good decisions for sure.

Ordered our team meeting. Food delivered. Driver accused me of not paying for my food over the phone prior to him delvering. Driver hestiant to call. After a discussion driver called store and was assured that I paid over the phone. Driver was asked about our free soda. Driver stated I didnt order enough for free soda when clearly my receipt showed. I called the store. Store accused me of not having chicken instead of salmon when I can clearly see and smell chicken. I was instructed to send food back with driver. Driver arrived again still no free soda even though driver was tipped very well. Store called me back an additional time to accuse me again of not sending food back or receiving wrong order. 
I dont know who owns this place but they are ridiculous never again.

If I could, I'd give them 0 stars. And if I could, I'd take away all the stars they already have. 1 group of my friends walked in before we got up to the door from the parking lot. Didn't charge 3 of my girlfriends. When I walked up they said everyone was $15. 

I explained I already knew they hadn't charged 3 if my friends they denied it. 

I watched them not charge 3 people who walked in while I waited on the side. 

Then when I walked up with the rest of our friends from the parking lot (I only decided to go in because it was my friend's birthday) they charged everyone $15 (including a friend of mine who is a VERY attractive professional cheerleader so you know this wasn't completely about looks) except my 1 guy friend in the group who winked at the girl at the front they charged him $10. 

The woman at the checkout had heavy makeup. Curly brown hair she parted to the side - with some sort of partially striped top for her costume. And worked with the short security girl in front who wore glasses who "backed up" her story. 

Lucky for them it was my friends birthday.

Absolutely awful service and disrespect. Needless to say - if you don't look Spanish or Hispanic you might get charged. Never again.

I normally love Panda, but would not recommend this location. The employee working, mind you there was no one else in the drive-thru, didn't give me my change. When I asked for my change she got extremely rude, & then to find out she didn't even give me what I ordered? Very unsatisfied with this location.
The service and food was good, large portions but  felt there drinks were very expensive. And NO senior discount's.

Fun afternoon spot for tacos!! Highly recommend doing the triple play-- 3 tacos for $9! This is especially a good deal because most of the tacos are between $4-9 so you save money by doing this option. The triple plays all come with some chips and salsa as well. 

The kids meals are a great deal. $5 for a large plate of food! We ordered the fish and chips which came with 2 large pieces of fish and a boatload if French fried (which were delicious).

We ordered chips and guacamole bc we didn't realize the tacos would come with chips. It was $6 but came with a LARGE serving of guac which seemed like a good deal of the amount they gave!! 

There was a long line but it was worth it bc we all loved all the tacos we ordered!! Seemed like the fried fish and fried shrimp were the top 2 favorites of our group. For the gluten free needs the grilled shrimp and carne asada (sub corn tortilla) were the two favorites. Go check it out and play at the batting cages while you're there!

We went Sunday for my daughters Bday, the service was so bad we actually thought we were being filmed for a prank.  The restaurant was not crowded but it took 40 minutes just to get water.  The meals came out sporadically which is a shame because the food was actually good but the entire experience ruined it.  I give this place 6 months before they go out of business, again..
This location rarely has decaf available as a selection. I have tried to order decaf espresso drinks on several occasions. They are either out or are "cleaning the machine".

If you know Hodak's from years - even decades - ago, rest assured. It's exactly as you remember it.

Hodak's offers traditional fried chicken dinners with all the fixin's. Other entrée choices include shrimp, fried fish, country-fried steak, and chicken livers (yes, it seems everything is fried.) They're also known for wings and fried mushrooms. Portions are VERY generous; in fact, I've never tried their desserts because I've never had room. 

The fried chicken is moist and tasty - some of the best I've had in town. Seasoning is light, which I don't think is a bad thing; it tastes like chicken instead of spices. Chicken livers are absolutely perfect, and enough for about three meals for me. As other reviewers have mentioned, the mashed potatoes and gravy are unremarkable and the fries are the fat crinkly sort that never seem crisp enough. Cole slaw is vinegary (not creamy) and on the acidic side. Salads are mostly iceberg lettuce. 

We've gotten take-out from Hodak's a couple times during the pandemic. It's really easy; just order and pay online, then call or text when you arrive at the designated curbside pickup spaces. I was disappointed in the way my last order was packed; a three-section styrofoam container held chicken livers, mashed potatoes and gravy, and slaw. The vinegary dressing from the slaw got into the other compartments, so the chicken livers on the bottom were soaking in it; I couldn't eat those.

My husband and I have been searching for  a new sushi restaurant since our absolute favorite sushi restaurant switched ownership a year ago. We finally found a place again that does the traditional rolls WELL, like Arizona, spicy yellowtail, spider, and succeeds in their originals without overdoing it. Crazy lobster was scrumptious. Service was perfect. Atmosphere was better than my previous favorite sushi restaurant. Happy hour was surprisingly great sushi for a great price! Super grateful to have found Mike's Sushi:)
The food was good.  Seafood great!  Steak bland...  The staff wasn't energetic, they seemed displeased with their job.  Displeased may be the wrong choice of words, but you rarely even saw a smile

My sister and I came through for some custard. While ordering, the girl taking our order kept rudely interrupting us and there was screaming and laughing in the background that was distracting our order taker. We finally get to the window and again, they were all just messing around. We waited at the window for 10 minutes while they just messed around like monkeys in the back, yes they were teenagers but the worst part is there was an older lady who liked like the manager right there screwing around with them! literally so rude. Also, there were NO other cars behind us , and we just ordered 2 regular custards, it doesn't take over 10 minutes to make some ice cream guys... step it up night shift! Never going back to this location. Worst customer service I have EVER gotten.

This used to be my favorite go to place for tacos in Nashville. 
But the service is constantly unpleasant...always. We always felt we were intruding being there to dine. I continued to dine here with my friends regardless because the tacos were good ...but after the bathroom flooded one day and was left unclean or picked up, I had to stop going. I told the owner about it and his response was "What do you want me to do about it?"  Hmmm.... close off the bathroom and clean up the mess all over the floor for starters .. 
So I no longer go ...
I love this location of Firehouse subs! The employees are so nice, and the store is always very clean. I eat here a few times a month. The food is consistently great!

Listen to the reviews. This is the most hilarious excuse for a restaurant that I've ever come across. Even for Papa John's - Come on... the bar is set ridiculously low for Papa John's. And this place still fails. Order your cheap pizza elsewhere. Pretty sure you can grab Five Points or Desanos for a couple extra bucks and not have to deal with this place. Trust me, it's worth it. You will not regret it.
That was the best cannelloni I've ever had!!! Great staff amazing food. Make the trip here you will not regret it
Never an issue here. Sometimes the line can get a little long, but the team moves quickly. Certainly has been cleaned up quite a bit in here.

Seamless carryout process during Covid. Love that they sell their margs in bottles. My fiancé ordered a beef chimichanga, it was warm and came with all the fixings. I had enchiladas and it was a generous portion but I wasn't able to stop eating :) tastes great to support small business!

My wife and I went there for are 20th anverersry dinner tonight The food was amazing, are waiter Anthony was very friendly and helpful went above  to make the dinner special for my wife and I one thing he did was on are dessert plate it said happy  anniversary  in closing I went to thank Anthony and seebeeze inland grill for a amazing evening !        Scott d

I came here with my family to get a drink and watch football. The manager physically assaulted my father because we were "standing in the walkway of the servers." Meanwhile the hostess told us we could stand behind the bar and enjoy our drinks while waiting for a table and there was plenty of room for servers to pass by without having to alter their path.

The hostess and the bartender were very pleasant and I feel bad that they have to deal with that a-hole manager each shift. He's ruining their service reputation and I hope he loses his job for the way he treats paying customers.

Ordered takeout and I'd have to say it's decent Chinese food but really great service! The owner gave me an egg roll on the house and a free fountain soda! She also took out my tip that I left on my receipt. Definitely recommend

This has become our favorite go to pizza!  Even though they don't deliver to my sub division, I love the Marco's on 60! I don't even mind going on Friday evenings to pick it up because it's so delicious!

Been going here for my pizza for about 15 yrs now. The staff is alway friendly and I never had a bad pizza or Stromboli..  place is located just off Bustleton  Pike( at the top of the hill if coming from Philadelphia).

This place is simply sad. I have been here a number of times throughout the years and they have managed to mess up something as simple as avocado toast about 75% of the time. I have been served with the avocado so thin it was like butter. And other times the avocado has turned brown before it reaches me. Sometimes the bread is cut sideways with one side incredibly thicker than the other, or burnt to a crisp. However today was the last straw. There was a giant rip in the bread. For the price of this ($9), I would expect absolute perfection. Avocado on bread is not hard to perfect. It is absolutely ridiculous that they have managed to get it wrong almost every time. You would think that if something looked off they would remake it before they brought it to you. It doesnt take more than a few minutes to remake. Or the waiter might notice and have them remake. But no, somehow it is perfectly okay to serve awful looking toast that is easy to make perfect, over and over. This shows the laziness and incompetence of the employees. Considering how much i'm paying this is unacceptable.

The only reason I didn't give them 5 stars is because the hostess was rude and she had an attitude and started our experience off on a bad note.  We would have left had we not been really hungry.  However, the bartender, waitress and manager were so friendly and fun and gave us excellent service.  We went in for breakfast and bottomless mimosas.  The bartender made sure our glasses were never empty. The corn grits are so good and the pontchartrain benedict was delicious.  They have a vodka infused with olives, onions and greenbeans for the bloody mary's, very tasty.  Now, the oysters!!!  We had oysters at several different establishments while visiting NOLA, these were the best, very clean, cold, sweet and briney, sooooo good.  We ended up going back the next morning for breakfast.  Give this place a try, you won't be disappointed.

Dinner at Adele's made for an excellent night out. From the airy layout to the open kitchen to the stellar service -- they made it a meal to remember. 

All of the menu items we ordered were delicious. We tried several starters and three entrees. Each one just as tasty as the next. The menu is seasonal and that makes me excited to return this summer. 

Make reservations. If you're into seeing the action and where the magic happens, request a table by the kitchen. It's worth the wait.

Love this place. The food and service was excellent! Best Mexican in food. Steak fajitas, made to order guacamole, and my husband's huge and delicious burrito were all delicious. Best Mexican on the Main Line!
Good food & service. Our waiter was wonderful and definitely made sure we never wanted for anything. The food was tasty and flavorful. A little bit of a wait but that showed us it was a popular spot.

On the 23rd my husband and I went to pollo loco. We paid with our bank card. On the 24th there was 2 charges of the same amount going through my bank account!!! On the 25th one charge cleared and the second disappeared. On the 26th the 2nd charge is back!!!!! I called them and they want me to bring in a bank statement. That they need to fax it to their office. I asked how long will they take to refund my account,  she said it could be days. (Really!!!) After they determine their decision I can go back and pick up my money.. that's such B.S... oh she (meaning the assistant manager) mentioned that I'm not the only one that has called them an complained about this issue...

Went to sampan for happy hour and they had $5 drink and food. I highly recommend the pork bao buns and the Korean beef satay! Super tender meat. The kimchi rice was also good and was so cheap! The only thing I didn't love was that the drink were super tiny.

I used to come here all the time, the owner is amazing and so is the staff. The last few times the sushi has not been very good.. more rice then filling, not rolled nicely and I hate the fact the they put the fried sushi thats hot in with the cold sushi. I hate that I am disappointed but I guess it's time to move elsewhere, sad.
Sean and Tammy were great! My husband and I had date night here tonight and were blown away by the service and the food. The steak I ordered was better than Ruth's Chris.

I will be generous and give it a three star. I've eaten there several times, and it is typically average. Today really sucked and I think I won't go back again.  I simply ordered a corn beef on rye with coleslaw and Russian dressing on the sandwich.   What arrived was corn beef that look like it is never seen a steamer.  Most of it was so dry it was shriveled. And it was on a grilled rye bread as if you would've ordered a Reuben. When the waitress brought it out I told her I did not order it with grilled bread. She offered to take it back and switch the bread and use the same meat. At that point I just said I'll eat it as is. Just changing the bread would not improve it that much since the meat was pretty unimpressive looking. The macaroni salad that I ordered as a side had no flavor whatsoever. I don't believe I will return there to eat. Just not what I like or expect in a good corn beef sandwich

I was super excited that this location delivered to my house. I love this pizza, I have ordered from the Georgetown location forever. I was highly disappointed, there was so much sauce that the pizza was soggy, maybe because there were not many toppings (I ordered sausage, pepperoni, onions and banana peppers).
The delivery was fast and the driver was friendly, hence the 2 stars.....

Inside heart of Peddler's village, parking right near restaurant, beautiful views of holiday lights (around Christmas time), very average food, slightly overpriced, average service, cute/historic vibe.

You guys, taxman city way is the place to go for takeout (or even socially distant indoor and patio outdoor seating). They have the best bar food. The burgers have the most amazing flavors combined to make something so delicious you'll eat it twice in a week (no joke). Also, they have crispy fries which, let's be honest, how all fries should be. Get some beers to go and you have yourself a nice little evening!
We always get excellent service and tonight was no exception. Jade is one of the best. Friendly and super helpful. We love coming to this location at least once a week.

This place has a storied history that is well worth your reading of the menu or a trip down the Google rabbit hole. I won't dig into all that here, but you should.

Incredibly cool spot with a great menu of food (the scallops - OMG) and excellent cocktails. They feature live entertainment and burlesque, and on some nights they can be a little crowded, with the occasional attempt to charge a cover (which is asking a little much given the costs of the menu items).

There isn't a bad seat in the house, but the front dining area along the catwalk for the girls is one of the best if you're not just hanging at the bar. Their staff is quick and professional and their managing partner, David, is one of the finest and most consummate hosts in town.

So I get teased for ordering plain cheese pizzas and glad to see there are others out there that appreciate a cheese pie. I have been craving a real NY cheese pizza and have been disappointed at my recent stops, so I had to take the communities advice and try Smiling with Hope. Great cheese pizza and the owners are so nice. They checked on my husband and I while dining in house. I hate to admit it, but we were able to down a whole large pizza!  I couldn't stop eating it. Good sauce, quality ingredients and totally satisfied.

Outback used to be our go to do steak house we used to go 2 to 3 times a month. ,Over the last few years the quality has gone down hill and this is no longer our go to. We decided to give it another shot so went for ribeye steaks last night, asked for extra seasoning since the seasoning is one item we have noticed has is nothing like it used to be. I ordered the 18 oz on the bone ribeye my wife got the 12 oz ribeye both medium. when the steaks came out they were 1/4 inch thick at best my wife's has no color just a odd tan color, they were both lacking seasoning. The steaks put you in mind if something you would find in a buffet not a steak house. The only bright spot was the coconut shrimp were still good. Not a 90 dollar experience more like a sizzler 14 dollar steak.
Cafè Caribe is my favorite place to have breakfast at. They have great prices good food and there employees are nice.

Firstly this is undoubtedly our favorite wing spot in the area. So why the mediocre star rating? Let's get into to it.

The good: This place has a huge variety of wing flavors and we have found quite a few favorites out of the bunch. Gold Rush, Fireball, Cheddar Jalepeño to name a few. We also love that they have a wing bar on Mondays! It always has a great variety and is well worth the money! 

It's also quite large and can easily accommodate a party of 6 without much of a hassle at all. I don't think we've ever waited more than 5 minutes for a table. 

The just ok: service has been spotty. Sometimes we have a great server and sometimes we literally have had to grab a random server because we haven't been acknowledged for a good 15-20 minutes after being seated. It's 50/50 but the wings keep us coming back. 

The bad: ok so this is our biggest complaint about wild wing cafe. The musical acts. There are times we will have a get together with friends and literally cannot hear a word being said. Trying to place an order you find yourself screaming at the server. Now we totally understand that this is a part of the thing that makes wild wing what it is, so our problem isn't with the fact that they have music, but the times that they start. We've been there during regular dinner hours (around 6:30-7) and then the musical acts starts and it's all down hill from there. Because of this the frequency that we've been returning has decreased outside of Mondays for the wing bar. 

This

The food is delicious, the portion sizes are HUGE, the price is good too considering you're getting 2-3 meals out of one order. My whole family loves this restaurant and we regularly order from here. The dessert and chai is amazing. Many times when I've gone out with friends I took them all to Hadramout for a night cap :) 

The service is great too!
Great Value and Great Food.  This is the number breakfast place in tucson az.

I just want to give a shout out to our waiter, Nat, and what a wonderful job he did.  Very talkative and informative and just down right nice.  Food was great also, so when you decide to eat at Coterie, ask to sit at one of Nat's tables!  Promise you won't go wrong!!

Loved the 60's themed diner experience. With COVID precautions, Baby's has gone above and beyond. All staff are wearing masks, guests are asked to wear masks when not at table. They take your temperature at the door, which we really liked as well. As for the experience, it was overall great. They have an extensive cocktail menu. They have several seasonal cocktails that are on tap, which I was hesitant about but i LOVED the festivus drink which came with a rosemary sprig. For my second drink I got the YAAAAAAS! Both of my drinks were perfect for me, light, not too sweet but fruity. My husband got the Sir Elton John and the Halleloo. I would come back here for just drinks they were so good! For dinner we shared the buffalo fries, which we really liked! They were lightly drizzled with buffalo sauce and had blue cheese and small celery pieces. My husband got the baby strutt burger, and added an extra patty. I got the half broasted chicken. If you liked fried chicken, you will really love Baby's broasted chicken, it is extremely crispy. My only complaint was it took about 30 minutes longer than my husband's to come out--we didn't mind too much. The wait staff mentioned that they had several to go orders come in and they can only cook a certain number of the chickens at a time. A wonderful spot and evening! Definitely recommend if you're in the area!

I've followed Tony at each of his locations. I have to say, this is his best restaurant. It is located in a brick building originally constructed in 1918. The "new" Mungo's has high ceilings, brick walls and a ton of light. The serving dishes and tables are a bit more casual and fun. We loved the new location. I actually think it is closer from North O'Fallon than the former O'Fallon location near Marcus Theater. The is also a lot parking in a city lot next to the restaurant. 

The star of the show is always the food! We had the fantastic toasted ravioli and Original Mungo's salad. Our entrees were chicken brochettes and Beef Mudiga, our favorites. Tony came by to ask how the meal was with a big smile of his face. Of course, everything was great. You won't be disappointed at Mungo's

It was a pretty good pie, not a home run but I think it would be better if eaten there and still hot. Limited choices of toppings, I asked for garlic and that is not something they can add which I thought was odd. Anyway, not a bad pizza .

Love it. Amber is great. Drinks are great and great price. Pork rinds are one of a kind...come out cracking. Catfish nuggets fantastic. Creamed spinach was over salted but they replaced with a different side for us. Staff is great and accommodating.

Interesting location with cozy atmosphere. Sat in the heated patio  section for an early dinner with a friend.

Service was great and our lead server, Christina, was knowledgeable, polite and professional. Nice portions with surprisingly good entrees for a reasonable prices.

Hope to return for brunch in the near future.
Solid brunch spot in the rotation. Small but mighty menu. Space can be a little tight, prefer to go here earlier before it gets crowded.

This was the worst pizza I had in years. It was so dry I could hardly swallow it. Very little sauce and cheese. If this is the way they are cutting back when they need business the most, I won't be back. And my son who has a large family and orders there all the time will hear about my experience. We live close to Domino's and ran it home in minutes. It was cold, the crust was tough and super dry. I always loved Domino's but this will get me to try other places.
To make matters worse, I called the store, got a young lady who only told me that she was sorry. If they can't make it right then they don't deserve business. She just told me "sorry" in an upbeat way. I told her I would be leaving honest feedback and she did not care. I won't be back.

I've heard the rumors. Yes they are true!
Arguably one of the best Italian meals I've ever had.
 I was thrown off at first when my lobster Showed up in a soup. But it was divine.
Great cocktails, great service. You're meal won't be cheap. But it's also worth it. 
We will be back

I can't say how grateful I am that there is a Joella's that's closer to downtown. This place is amazing, the breading on the chicken is a perfect balance between enough to make it crispy but not too much to where there isn't much chicken. The seasoning on the chicken is amazing!!!! The sides you can choose, are delicious. The Mac n cheese is creamy and flavorful and the dipping sauces are phenomenal. I chose the Pimento Ranchero, I could eat that for days, so delicious and so good for dipping chicken tenders in. The prices were also great, I think the value you receive for what you pay is great. Not gonna lie, it is a chain, but it has a great local broad ripple feel!
Very good salads! And amazing mustard! The patio here will be an awesome summer hangout. 10/10 recommend

I was SO excited to try this place! I got the Tostones Nachos with avocado salad as the "protein" (that was their only vegetarian option). My Tostones were soggy (it only took me ten minutes to get home) and didn't seem like they had been cooked long enough to start with. The pico and avocado salad were both EXTREMELY bland, I'm honestly not sure there was any seasoning or citrus at all. Other than cabbage, that was all that was on them. Definitely not worth the 30 minute wait, and overall super disappointing.
Terrible establishment. Wouldn't let a group of 17 and 18 year olds come and play games

Best pizza place around, and their wings are a MUST order!!! The pizza is coal fired though, so be prepared for thinner crust with burnt edges. I'd also not recommend getting via delivery service because the pizza is not as fresh and usually cold.

Found a nice local place for breakfast. Service was great, food was great. However, a local that sat at the counter was very boisterous and kind of ruined my dining experience. Other than that, I would recommend this place.

Best brewery in Reno......, Always great beer selection and the food is amazing if you order the right dish. I personally love the Thai peanut chicken wings and the sausage platter.

The employees are always nice and attentive. We have had servers by the name of Elizabeth, Sarah and Paige. Each one of these ladies are about as professional as they come. Good food, great beer and exceptional service.... 5 stars.

Thanks, James, Kelly, and Bentley

Go check out the good eatin' at @marieskitchennola!!! They've got got some of the best gumbo I've had outside of someone's house!
-
Y'all for real I rarely order gumbo out bc I know someone's mama makes it better, but the dark & smokey chicken and sausage gumbo from the chef at @marieskitchennola is out of this world. It's served with a creamy scoop of potato salad, too

A super hole in the wall place, but it was delicious! A hidden gem for sure, my friends and I came here and the staff was amazing and was so happy so serve us. The food was incredible. Would love to come back!
Best Italian food I have ever ate. The chief and server was the same person. He was amazing. Would recommend this place to all my family and friends
Old school joint with great sandwiches and a huge selection of drinks. I would come here again if I'm ever back in New Orleans

Ordered takeout twice. Excellent baba ganoush- nice and smokey as it is supposed to be. Falafel was also excellent and freshly fried at order. Very good tabouli too. Chicken shawarma was wonderful as well. Down to earth, friendly ownership.

Great Italian sandwich spot. My usual order is the Ni Cola sandwich toasted. The Ni Cola has roasted peppers, broccoli rabe, balsamic glaze, tomatoes, and arugula, and I ask to added mozzarella cheese. While I have not yet tried a different sandwich, there are numerous options for all tastes and diets. 

The only con is the chips that the sandwich comes with aren't of the best quality.

I'll probably update this once I get my food but: 

1. They weren't necessarily kind to everyone when telling them they needed to use a QR Code to get on the wait list.

2. I was originally given a time frame of 10:39-10:54 am to be seated on the waitlist and didn't get seated until 11:15. Which I get they can't necessarily control how long people take to eat or how long the kitchen takes to prep food. 

3. Staff seemed like they were in a rush to get people to order, which I understand they get the idea that you've been waiting for a minute so why not have your mind made up. But the other person in my group ended up changing their mind because of the wait.

If i would have known how small my Swiss Mushroom Burger was going to be I'd have ordered 2. I waited in line for 55minutes. There is no place to turn around. The Edemami was not cleaned...They serve them with the strings and the stems LEFT ON THEM!! They have to be prepared just like string beans are prepared. Who does NOT know this?? I had to throw both orders away. So sad. 
Victoria Normand

Food is amazing here, Breakfast is my favorite. But I come for the lunch more! Ask for Jenny she is such a sweet heart, I love her. I always ask for her when I can! My favorite chocolate chip pancakes and bacon lol
Foods always fresh, service is always good and the new location is set up great. Very clean. The pizza is delicious and The wings are so good!

The beer selection is amazing! Choices for all different flavor lovers.

The wings are like nothing I've had before. They are not very breaded but still have great flavor. The seasoning rubs are very different than anything I've had other places. The light to no breading makes the wings not feel super heavy to eat.

Deep dish pizza was delicious. Very very cheesy!

Just moved to Reno from Los Angeles, CA few months back. Having lived in Ktown, we have pretty high expectations for korean food.

When I checked the menu prices on yelp, seemed a bit expensive, but when we ordered, portions were massive! At least for what we ordered.

we got:
grilled mackeral (ask for lemons!) combo with spicy vege tofu soup
seafood green onion pancake

all the banchan (side dishes) were spot on! Even bought some kimchee to go!

All in all, didnt expect to find such an authentic korean restaurant here in Reno. Definitely excited to go back and try some other stuff

I know many people are sheltering in place but we needed to get out into the world. I appreciate a small restaurant as I think there can be better quality control when it comes to following safety guidelines.
Thankfully we can walk here from our house. They do have a small happy hour menu (beer & wine and 5 food items)
All the food we had was really good. The special salmon burger with fries was very large and tasty. I had the vegetarian plate and it was diverse and colorful and fresh and very filling. They have amazing baked good here (I think one of the owners is a trained baker). I had a bite of my friend's carrot cake and it was light and not too sweet. I look forward to going back soon and sitting on the patio (it was raining tonight)

Ott's is a traditional bar and fish stand, the locals come daily for the fish and drink of the day! Otts is the place to be, people come from all around for their famous fish stand! The new owners have kept the tradition of great fish, great beer and family friendly atmosphere! And best of all they now they offer local brews and craft beers!

Great pizza, mistaken delivery person. Delivery person called me. Said order was for 176, not 174. Not correct. Had my boyfriend go out to greet person. If there was a problem, i wouldn't be messaging the company.

BLOOMSDAY Cafe is one of the prettiest cafes you'll see in Philadelphia. Right from the big green door at the entrance, to the visually stunning vertical moss walls, to the elegant bar area, every space in the cafe is exceptionally beautiful. 

Even the coffee mugs are very instagrammable. From locally sourced flavors to pretty designs on your lattes, a lot of care and attention to detail goes into making an individual cup of coffee. The cocktails deserve a special shout out because the cocktail menu is carefully tweaked to complement the meal and the time of day.

You could just stop by to pick up coffee and pastries if you're not in a mood for sit down dining, but be sure to drop in before lunch time because they run out of baked goods pretty fast.
It was a nice clean restaurant that practice social distance.  Customer service was great and food was good.

While in Fishers, my wife wanted something traditional for lunch, not anything new and adventurous like I might try.  So, nothing says traditional in the area like Sahm's!

We pulled into their shared lot in the shopping plaza just south of 116th on the east side of the street.  There is a hostess stand which you wait at to be seated and then you are escorted to either a table or booth.  The interior is quite dark for a restaurant, but I guess they see themselves as a pub, so that is to be expected.  

The interior also seems a bit dated.  The fabrics on some of the benches were fading.  Though clean, it just seems to need a bit of life added to the dining room.  That somewhat shows since the average age of the customers was 50+.  It just doesn't have the 'wow' factor that appeals to younger customers.

We placed our orders and noticed that our server was quite busy.  He never stopped moving from table to table.  My wife ordered the Chili Cheese Dog.  It came with some really tasty fries.  Our table's supply of ketchup was empty, so she needed to use one from another table since our waiter didn't deliver the food to our table and didn't get back for awhile.  My wife thought the sandwich was fine, but the hot dog was rather average.  Nothing special about it.

I ordered from the lunch special and got the 1/2 salad and soup option.  I went with the Chicken Velvet which was really good.  Lots of veggies and some shredded chicken.  (Note that a clam chowder was originally brought

Food was fantastic BUT it took over an hour to get our entrees waiter seemed to be elsewhere!!
Next time I will sit in the bar awesome bartender

I finally got the chance to try this place out and the food was good but what was the best and stood out from the rest was my server.i positive her name was April becouse you don't forget someone like that.she was so kind and was very knowledgeable when it came to the menu.She stayed on top of everything we needed while making sure the rest didn't want for anything.top of the line sever and can't get any better.the charbroiled oyster were amazing with the jambalaya.I will be back only this time with more friends and I'll be sure to ask for the same server.Thanks Felixs for a time to remember.

I found this restaurant/bar on Yelp and decided to give it a try. Boy was I in for a treat. I ordered the street corn, a blood orange IPA and No Bull Beyond Burger with fries. The street corn was the best I've ever had. The burger and fries were great. The beer was good too. I can't wait to come back.

Today was my first visit to Savanh of Laos, but it won't be my last! My friend and I stopped in right when they re-opened at 4pm. We shared a bowl of Tom Kha Gai soup with chicken which is my favorite soup of all time. This was the best I have ever had. The broth was so silky and flavorful and all of the ingredients mixed in were bright and fresh. We also split the Panang Curry which is another favorite of mine, and was equally as delicious. The atmosphere is beautiful and clean, with fresh roses and hand sanitizer on every table. The woman who took care of us also prepared our meals (I believe) and she was incredibly welcoming and hospitable. My friend and I agreed you could truly taste the care and love the food was made with.This place is an absolute gem and I look forward to returning many more times and sampling more of their wonderful menu.
THE best sushi around. Aztec roll is my favorite followed my Dunedin's dream, Pink Panther and so many others.

Absolutely LOVED this place. Super chill and GREAT food. The bartender recommended I try the spicy ramen bowl and I had it with chicken and extra hardboiled egg. I omitted the fish cake and lemon. I also had some delicious salmon and avocado rolls on the side and green tea. The green tea was super authentic tasting with ground tea flakes and a lovely minty aftertaste. The salmon rolls went down fast and smooth and I STILL have some of this soup leftover and have had two meals already with it. 

If you go there, sit at the bar and ask for Krystal! She's an amazing bartendress and very attentive to your every need. :)
